newsitem.title: USA: Environment One awarded $3 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Environment One awarded $3 mln in contracts.

text.p: Environment One Corp said on Tuesday it had been awarded contracts for two sewer systems projects with a combined value of more than $3 million.
The two projects are valued at $2.3 million and $800,000, Environment One said in a statement.
"These new E/One Sewer jobs, which will be shipping in the second half, are indicators of significantly heavier sales volume over the first half of 1997," said company chief executive Stephen Ardia.
Environment One provides products and services for residential and sanitary waste.
